Hi Sam — quick engineering notes to answer your questions: 

1) top_k & determinism:
- The reranker API accepts a top_k param; ordering is deterministic for a given model version and input stream. Minor model updates (patches) may change scores; we recommend pinning a model version for eval runs.

2) Scores & outputs:
- The /v1/rerank endpoint returns an array of candidate objects with both raw score (float) and normalized_score (0-1). If you enable debug=true, we also return feature attributions and token-level highlights. Example response snippet: 
  {candidate_id: "c1", raw_score: 2.34, normalized_score: 0.91}

3) Top_k tuning guidance:
- Default top_k = 10. For evaluation, we recommend a sweep over top_k = [5, 10, 20, 50] and report NDCG@k and MRR@k for each. Latency scales roughly linearly with top_k for the reranker-only pass — expect +x ms per additional candidate depending on model size.

4) Embedding flow & hybrid approach:
- Pattern A (recommended for scale): store candidate embeddings in your vector DB; run cheap candidate gen (semantic search), then fetch top_N candidates and call /v1/rerank with those candidates' text + optional precomputed embeddings.
- Pattern B (simpler): call Redwood embeddings endpoint at eval time for small batches. Both are supported.

5) Auth & sandboxing:
- We can generate a time-limited sandbox API key scoped to the rerank and embeddings endpoints. For Private deployments we support token exchange via your SSO; let us know which you prefer.

6) Eval tooling:
- Attached eval_script.py is a starter that: calls /v1/embeddings (optional), constructs candidate lists, calls /v1/rerank, and computes NDCG/MRR using scikit-learn helpers.

Inline curl example (simplified):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"How do I reset my password?","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Reset password via settings"},{"id":"c2","text":"Contact support to reset"}],"top_k":10}'

I'll follow up with a sandbox key if Marissa confirms and with a pinned model version we recommend for the initial run (small-variant-rerank-v1).

- Dev
